<!--
  The first screen of an app: counters, a chart and recent activity. Axes: layout (split: the chart and the
  activity side by side, stacked: one below the other), cols (2, 4), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { OverviewChart, OverviewActivity } from "./dashboard-overview.types";
  import type { Metric } from "./metric-row.types";
  import type { Point } from "./chart-panel.types";
  import type { Event } from "./activity-feed.types";

  export type DashboardOverviewProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    metrics: Metric[];
    chart: OverviewChart;
    activity: OverviewActivity;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    cols?: "2" | "4";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import BarChart from "../components/bar-chart.svelte";
  import Panel from "../components/panel.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.svelte";
  import Timeline from "../components/timeline.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    metrics,
    chart,
    activity,
    layout = "split",
    cols = "4",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: DashboardOverviewProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density}>
  <Stack gap="6" align="stretch">
    <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1-4")} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each metrics as m (m.id)}
        <Block tag="div" data-testid="item">
          <StatTile label={m.label} value={m.value} icon={m.icon} hint={m.hint} />
        </Block>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
    <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-stretch gap-4" data-testid="panels">
      <Panel title={chart.title} description={chart.text} id={tpl("{0}-chart", id)} class="h-full">
        <BarChart bars={chart.series} label={chart.summary} height={144} />
      </Panel>
      <Panel title={activity.title} description={activity.text} id={tpl("{0}-feed", id)} class="h-full">
        <Timeline items={activity.events} />
      </Panel>
    </Grid>
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
